extra.description: I wrote an assembler that supports floating point values. One of the operators I implemented was factorial because a lot of Taylor series seem to use it to define various constants. So right now, I have .float -((2*3.14159265)**11)/11! I found a bug in the parsing such that (2+3)! doesn't parse (the parsing of the factorial operator is in the wrong location).
